_comment: Programmes learners pick at onboarding — school boards, entrance exams, university coursework, professional qualifications and competitions (ADR 0008). Ids are stable: profiles and indexed chunks reference them, which is why some older ids end in -math although the programme now offers every subject. Subjects are ids from packages/schema/src/subjects.ts. Adding a programme is adding a row; `pnpm db:seed:curricula` loads it.
